rows.en: Second from the right
Third from the right
The one on the far left
Search somewhere else
Where should I look?
I checked the bookshelf.{p}

There were so many books that it took quite a while.
...In the end, there was nothing.{p}Where should I search next?
I checked the bookshelf.{p}

There were so many books that it took quite a while.
...Hm?
Something was tucked between the books.
It looked like a note.
Let's see...
"I'll be waiting at the back gate after school today."
...Arranging a date, maybe.
I found myself envying whoever wrote this note.
People living plain, peaceful, ordinary lives.
By rights, I should have been one of them.
Why did it have to come to this...
...No, I can't lose heart now.{p}I'll try searching somewhere else.
I decided to go to the library.{p}
What should I do?
Where should I search?

"Ugh..."
I twisted my face as if in agony.
Then I collapsed to the ground.
With luck, he might think the poison had kicked in.{p}

Hino came up close to me.
"What's this, you didn't take the antidote?"
He crouched down and looked at me.
Not yet.
He was still too far away for me to lunge in a single instant and snatch the knife.
"What a letdown you are."
Hino shrugged.{p}

And the next instant, he was on top of me.
Before I could spring up, a knife was plunged into my chest.{p}
A hot, numbing sensation sent my whole body into convulsions.{p}

Hino was grinning with delight.
"I'm at least taking the finishing blow for myself. Call it the least punishment you deserve for robbing me of my fun."
"P-punishment...?"
I forced my voice out desperately.
"That's right. Why do you think I let the people I liked into the Murder Club?"{p}

What★
That means... he was planning to kill those six too, in the end★
"Watching them die in despair was going to be the greatest pleasure of all.
Anyway, you're going to answer for this."
Blood gushed from my chest, throb after throb.
...I was cold.
My body wouldn't stop shaking.{p}

"But hey, you gave me a pretty good time yourself, {a}."
Hino kept on talking.
But I could hardly hear him anymore.
I'd been so close...
I never got to see the light of dawn.{p}

"Come on, Hino! Don't miss! Drive that knife into my gut as hard as you can!"
I shouted.
"Heh, giving up, are you?!"
Hino charged at me, laughing.
I focused every nerve I had on Hino's knife.
This was my last gamble.
If my luck held, it was sure to work.
It mustn't miss.
I had to take Hino's knife in exactly the right spot.{p}

If it missed... I'd die!
"Let me put you out of your misery!"{p}

"Ngh!"
A dull pain throbbed through my stomach.{p}

The next instant, a look of dismay spread across Hino's face.
This was something that must never happen to Hino.
"You bastard... you tricked me."
"What's wrong, Hino? You've gone white as a sheet."
With my left hand, I gripped Hino's hand along with the knife stuck in my gut.
Meanwhile, my right hand fumbled a mechanical pencil out of my pocket.
There wasn't a moment to lose.
Without hesitation, I thrust my right hand forward.{p}

"Gwah!"
The mechanical pencil struck Hino square in the throat.{p}

Bright red blood sprayed out in a burst.
"N... no way..."
Breath whistled out of the wound, wheeze, wheeze.
Then Hino's eyes rolled back until only the whites showed.
Like a marionette with its strings cut, he flopped to the ground.{p}

...He was dead.
I pulled the piece of window frame that had saved my life out from under my shirt.
To think that rotten wood like this, ready to snap at any moment, had saved me.
I wiped my face with the back of my hand.
It came away smeared with Hino's blood.
...If I went home like this, my family would be shocked for sure.
I giggled.
At the same time, tears welled up and wouldn't stop.
I'd won.
So why did I feel so wretched?
I sobbed and hiccuped like a child.
..............................I'm a murderer.
I'm a murderer.{p}

Just then, the morning sun shone in.
As if to accuse me of my crime.{p}
Without hesitation, I drove the screwdriver into Hino's throat.{p}

Without hesitation, I drove the screwdriver into Hino's chest.
The screwdriver went in without any resistance at all.
Hino's body was as soft as a sponge.
What the hell is this guy★{p}

As I froze in terror, Hino grinned at me.
"Is that all you've got?"
"Uh..."
I tried to scream.{p}
In that instant, a chop from Hino's bare hand sent my head flying.{p}

I pulled the screwdriver from my pocket and held it ready.
Hino grinned.
"Interesting. Prey's no fun unless it puts up a fight."
I focused every nerve on Hino's knife.
"Die, {a}☆"
Here it comes!{p}

I dodged the thrusting knife by a hair.
My shirt tore.
It was a first try with no rehearsal, but it worked.
Still, I had no time to celebrate.{p}

Hino had swung at empty air and lost his balance.
It's now or never!{p}

"I'm sorry, Hino. Please forgive me."
I bowed my head.
Hino was right.
I didn't have the strength left to fight anymore.{p}

"Then lick my shoes. You've done it before, so you can do it, right?"
Was he going to humiliate me even more than this?{p}What should I do?
Lick his shoes
Say no

"No!"
I said it flatly.{p}

"Figured you'd say that."
Hino's arm flashed out.{p}

A moment later, my throat went burning hot.
Everything before my eyes turned red.
He'd slit my throat!
I had to call for help.
...But no voice came out.
Only breath, leaking out in wheezes.
I collapsed.{p}
The last thing I saw was Hino, bathed in my spurting blood, laughing like a demon.{p}

"...All right."
I knelt and brought my face close to Hino's shoes.
If I didn't do it, he'd kill me.
With tears of shame in my eyes, I licked his shoes.{p}

Before I could even feel relieved, I was handed an ampoule.
This one was smaller, and the liquid was a pale blue.
"This one's not poison."
Hino smirked as he said it.{p}Should I drink it?
Drink it
Don't drink it

"I can't drink this."
I shook my head.{p}
Hino's eyes glinted.{p}

I gulped down the contents of the ampoule in one go.
For an instant the back of my throat felt cool, and then it flared up hot.{p}

"How is it?"
Hino asked with a smirk.
...I felt kind of hot.
And I could feel strength welling up from somewhere deep inside my body.
"All right then, starting today we get right to work.
Even you must have someone you want to kill, right?"
Hino said.
Of course I did.
The owner of the dog that always barks at me on my way to school.
The neighborhood lady who's always bragging that her son got into a better school than me.
The English teacher who always calls on me on exactly the days I haven't prepared.
And...{p}

Hino clapped me on the shoulder like an old pal.
"Well, let's take our time with it. The prey isn't going anywhere."
...That's true.
I thought for a moment, then nodded.
What was that drug Hino made me drink, anyway?
The thought crossed my mind.
But who cares about that.
I've got a mountain of things to do.
Right now, I feel like I could do anything.
Hino was laughing.
I bet he and I were going to be together for a long time to come.
I smiled back at my new best friend.{p}

"W-wait! I'll join the Murder Club after all!"
I said loudly.
Of course, I didn't mean it.
I wanted to put him at ease, then look for an opening.{p}

"Huh, changed your mind, have you?"
Hino grinned.{p}

Suddenly, my head swam.
I hurriedly looked at my watch.
The count was.................... zero☆
The strength was draining from my whole body.
Was I going to die?
I...{p}
In the very last moment, I thought I heard Hino laughing.{p}

"Fine, then put in a word for me with Hino.
I'll join the Murder Club."
I kicked Hosoda in the side.
He nodded exaggeratedly.
"You're letting me off★
Thank goodness. The ampoule's in the old school building.
Hey, call an ambulance for me..."{p}

Maybe out of relief, he collapsed onto the floor the moment he said that.
A loud crash rang out, like a wardrobe toppling over.
Hosoda was groaning in pain.
Like this, he's in no shape to put in a word with Hino.
I'll give up on joining the Murder Club.
Right now, finding the ampoule comes first.{p}
I left the old school building.{p}
Where should I go?
He shoved me aside and lunged at me.{p}

A screwdriver was stuck in Hino's shoulder.
He was clutching it, as if to shield the wounded shoulder.
Blood was faintly seeping out.
"...Why didn't you kill me?!"
Hino screamed.
Then he glared at me and bit his lip in frustration.
Blood dripped from the lip he bit so hard.
"...Because you're not even worth killing."
"Just watch! I'll curse you!
I'll curse you to death!"
Hino yanked the screwdriver out of his shoulder and stabbed it into his own ear.
"Gyah!"
Hino let out a short groan.
Then Hino's eyes rolled back until only the whites showed.
"...I...'ll... c...urse... y...ou... t...o... d...e...a......th..."
He fell.
It wasn't as if I couldn't have foreseen Hino taking his own life.
But I wasn't able to stop him.
I had no time to stop him, and even if I had, would I have stopped Hino?
"...If you want to curse me, go ahead. I'm not afraid of your curse.
Thanks to you, I've got the confidence to live strong."
No answer to my words came back from Hino.
By now, he must be riding the train to hell.{p}

I stepped into the payphone outside the school gate.
The morning sun was already starting to show beyond the sky.{p}

I dialed.
"...Hello, police? There's been a murder at the school. The school is at..."{p}

I told them everything and hung up.
I was abnormally sleepy.
It was hard to stay awake any longer.
I slumped down inside the phone booth as if collapsing.
...Even keeping my eyes open was hard now.
I closed my eyes.
And I sank into a deep sleep.
When I wake up, maybe I'll skip school, just for today.
...As my consciousness faded, the wail of police sirens echoed through my head.{p}
Where should I go?

The knife is gone!
I must have dropped it somewhere.{p}
